fields.longtitle: Job openings at LBar micropigmentation studio in Bucharest
fields.description: Job openings at LBar micropigmentation studio in Bucharest: permanent makeup artist, eyelash extension artist and manicurist (nail technician)

tvs.description-banner-inerial:
We are actively looking for talented, experienced specialists who want to work in a modern studio, in good conditions and for a competitive salary.

Permanent makeup artist

We have an opening for a permanent makeup artist. Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of experience or a minimum of 400 procedures performed.
  • A personal portfolio so we can assess the quality of your work.
  • Knowledge of permanent makeup techniques: hair-stroke brows, powder brows micropigmentation, aquarelle lips, lower/upper eyelid tattoo, eyeliner.
  • Ability to work quickly and to a high standard while following safety rules.
  • Resilience under stress.
  • Ability to find the right approach to every client.

To inquire about this position, send us photos of your work on Instagram.

Eyelash extension artist

We have an opening for an eyelash extension artist.

Requirements:

  • Knowledge of 2D, 3D, 5D, 6D and Hollywood eyelash extension techniques.
  • At least 1 year of experience or more than 400 completed sets.
  • A personal portfolio showcasing your work.
  • Ability to handle a heavy workload.

To inquire about this position, send us photos of your work on Instagram.

Manicurist (nail technician)

Our studio is looking for an experienced manicurist.

Requirements:

  • Ability to work with a variety of manicure techniques.
  • Ability to use different materials and techniques for coating natural nails, as well as for nail extensions and strengthening.
  • A personal portfolio showcasing your work.
  • At least 1 year of experience or more than 400 completed jobs.

To inquire about this position, send us photos of your work on Instagram.
